content: {"action":"appeal_with_necessity","reasoning":"The claim has a CO-197 denial, while the retroauthorization window is closed and Meridian offers no peer-to-peer review. Resubmission or records alone would not cure the missing authorization, and billing the patient for the full denied balance would exceed the contractual 20% share. A formal medical-necessity appeal is the only available payer-directed action that can progress recovery."}
